data.fund_type: An open ended debt scheme predominantly investing in ﬂoating rate instruments. A Relatively High interest rate risk andRelatively Moderate Credit Risk (B-III)
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to generate reasonable returns and reduce interest rate risk by investing in a portfolio comprising predominantly of ﬂoating rate instruments and ﬁxed rate instruments swapped for ﬂoating rate returns. The Scheme may also invest a portion of its net assets in ﬁxed rate debt securities and money market instruments. However there can be no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved. The Scheme does not guarantee / indicate any returns.
data.asset_allocation: Floating Rate Debt Securities (including Securitised Debt & Fixed Rate Debt Instruments swapped for ﬂoating rate returns): 65-100% (Low to Medium) Debt and Money Market Securities (including Triparty Repo on Government Securities or treasury bill & Repo): 0-35% (Low to Medium) Units issued by InvITs: 0-10% (Medium to High) *Investments in securitised debt, if undertaken, shall not exceed 50% of the net assets of the Scheme, $ In terms of SEBI Circular No. HO/24/13/12(1)2025-IMD-POD-2/I/157/2025 dated November 28, 2025 and applicable regulatory guidelines, any existing investments held by the debt schemes in units of REITs as on December 31, 2025 shall be grandfathered.
data.benchmark: CRISIL Short Duration Debt A-II Index
